name: Axis Football League 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Axis Football League is a fun and fast-paced American Football game in which you can compete in various football matches and leagues. Choose from a range of different AFL teams including the San Diego Storm, New England Volunteers an the New York Rockets - each team has different stats and excels at different areas of football such as passing, blocking and rushing.
